author: opencode-worker-7
text: Status consolidation (worker-7): the receiver-side slices of this bead are DONE — Python claim replay cache (SlotClaimReplayCache + verify_slot_claim replay gate, commit c89351eb05, closed as 20.2) and C NVS persistence (slot_claim_settings.c, closed as 20.1, gated CONFIG_LICHEN_SLOT_CLAIM_REPLAY). Remaining scope is the SENDER side (atomic increment-before-claim + NVS persistence in the sender's claim construction), which per worker-4's coordination note is part of the single-session COSE_Sign1 migration (16.1/16.2/16.4) that requires the human payload-keys adjudication first — the sender transcript format cannot be finalized before that decision. Adding human-only label so the loop skips it until the 70p7/16 adjudication completes.
